Synopsis:
Analysis by non-profit Foxglove finds two planned UK datacentres (Wapseys Wood, Bucks & Quest Park, Beds) will collectively consume 1.3GW and generate ~4.6Mt CO₂/yr — exceeding ExxonMobil's entire UK emissions. Both projects plan on-site gas-fired generation to bypass a congested grid connection queue (315 datacentres, 73GW pending). Environmental groups and MPs warn this threatens the UK's legally binding carbon budgets. The government defends the fast-track NSIP planning regime and claims multiple pathways exist to meet climate targets, but acknowledges uncertainty remains high.
